messages:
ana: Hey all — starting an initial preflight for AWS/GCP/Azure listing. Need to confirm roles, artifacts, and a minimal manifest we can hand to partner teams. Quick sync?

jake: yup. what do we have today for each cloud? AMI / container images / metadata?

maria: AWS: AMI + launch script. GCP: GCE image + gcs bucket for license/terms. Azure: VHD + managed image. Also we need marketplace metering SKU for all three.

ben_marketplace: adding SKU ask: for trial vs paid SKU, do we want separate offers or one offer with trial entitlement? Legal will likely prefer separate listing entries for clarity.

priya_legal: +1 separate SKUs recommended. Also need localized EULA files and a signed publisher agreement before we publish. I can draft a minimal EULA template if you want.

ana: @priya_legal yes please. also logistics: who owns the terraform/publisher bootstrap artifacts? we need registry creds for automated publish pipeline.

ben_marketplace: I can own the Terraform publisher repo. Need these inputs from infra/ops: service principal creds (least-privilege), a CI user with publisher role, and list of IPs for webhook allowlist.

sam_design: placeholder for hero image + 3 screenshots. File specs: 1280x720 jpg for hero, png transparent 300x300 for logo. We'll need alt text and localized captions.

jake: infra ask: for AWS we need the image manifest and a small cloud-init snippet. For GCP/Azure we need image export locations + checksum. Also would like a small sample repo with deployment terraform and a minimal app config for smoke test.

ana: putting a tiny manifest example here for devs to start from:

```json
{
  "product": "redwood-inference",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "images": {
    "aws": "ami-0abc1234redwood",
    "gcp": "gce-image-redwood-2025-03",
    "azure": "redwood-vhd-2025-03.vhd"
  },
  "artifacts": {
    "license": "s3://redwood-marketplace/licenses/redwood-eula-en-US.pdf",
    "trial_entitlement": "true",
    "support_contact": "support@redwood.ai"
  },
  "skus": [
    {"id": "RWINF-TRIAL", "type": "trial", "region_coverage": ["us-east-1","europe-west1","australia-southeast1"]},
    {"id": "RWINF-PRO", "type": "paid"}
  ]
}
```

maria: thanks. for checksums use sha256 and include a signed manifest. Also include a small signature file from our signing key: `manifest.sig`.

priya_legal: checklist I need from product for legal review:
- final EULA doc per locale
- proof of data processing (where logs/usage stored)
- support SLA summary
- security questionnaire answers (we have a template)

ben_marketplace: ops items:
- CI principal name: `redwood-marketplace-ci`
- permissions: publish:MarketplaceOffer, write:StorageObjects, iam:PassRole limited to publish role
- webhook endpoint for publish notifications: `https://publish-callback.redwood.ai/marketplace` (will provide cert)
- IP allowlist: 3 static IPs (TBD)

jake: build artifact workflow example (for infra team):

```bash
# build and push image to registry
make build-image && docker tag redwood:latest gcr.io/redwood-marketplace/redwood:2025-03 && docker push gcr.io/redwood-marketplace/redwood:2025-03
# export image for GCP marketplace
gcloud compute images export --destination-uri gs://redwood-marketplace/images/redwood-2025-03.tar.gz --image redwood-image
```

sam_design: small note on marketing assets: we need a one-line product description that fits marketplace hero: "Low-latency LLM inference with predictable cost and enterprise controls." Keep under 120 chars.

ana: question for team: do we include BYOL (bring-your-own-license) options in initial launch or wait for v2? BYOL adds extra entitlements mapping.

priya_legal: BYOL increases compliance checks — need explicit license flow and proof of license. recommend postpone unless partner requests it during onboarding.

ben_marketplace: Agreed. target initial launch without BYOL. If partner asks, we can scope in a separate offer.

maria: one more ops nuance: images must be in partner-owned registry for some marketplaces (e.g., Azure requires the publisher to own the image in Azure Marketplace). We'll need owner creds or coordinate partner-led image publish.

jake: ok. action items I captured:
1) ben_marketplace: create terraform-publish repo skeleton + CI principal request (due EOD Thu)
2) priya_legal: draft minimal EULA + localized placeholders (due Mon)
3) sam_design: hero + logos + alt text (first pass Fri)
4) ana: collect image exports & checksums, attach manifest.sig (due Tue)
5) maria: confirm AMI/VHD/GCE image names and share signed URLs (due Tue)
6) infra (jake): share CI pipeline example and required IAM policy (due Thu)

ben_marketplace: ack, will open repo and add initial README + TODOs.

deploy-bot: deployment pipeline build #482 started by ben_marketplace — status: queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ana: great. i'll run a short kickoff with the partner PMs tomorrow to walk this checklist through. anyone want to join?

maria: I can join for the image export piece.

priya_legal: I'll sit in for EULA + contract points.

sam_design: can do first 10 mins for assets.

ana: meeting at 10am PT tomorrow. calendar invite incoming. Thanks everyone!
